title: Bombus buzz
author: Mysid
changes: Bumblebee (Bombus), a close relative of the honey bee. Trimmed to 3.70–6.65 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 70 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 0.9 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
